propositions: Non-create plans (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict handling) must execute atomic desired postconditions in dependency order, preserving earlier successes and re-observing only remaining drift after partial failure within a shared budget.

Endpoint-scoped fuse opens after three consecutive eligible exhausted logical outcomes across at least two distinct tickets; provider-scoped fuse additionally requires outcomes spanning two or more distinct endpoints of the same provider; matching success resets consecutive counter state.
Physical attempts, recovered warnings, permanent failures, ticket-local 404s, and opaque diagnostics (commit_unknown) must be excluded from fuse counter increments.
commit_unknown disposition resolves as ticket-scoped (never stops siblings), projects to deferred bucket, is replay-forbidden, and is re-observed on next reconcile pass rather than re-issued.
When a fuse opens, remaining matching plans defer with explicit reason, scope, and retry_not_before metadata while independent scopes continue executing.
Applied, failed, deferred, skipped, and recovered tallies plus exit status must be exact and preserved across partial compound updates with no replay of the entire mutation after late failure.
